svg.text: Zirah Entropy Source and Secure-Element Bus
Avalanche breakdown of a reverse-biased base-emitter junction, amplified by an LM358 and sampled by the STM32F407 ADC on PA1. Part names match the breadboard drawings.
U1 pin 8 = 5V (C8 100 nF + C9 10 uF to GND), pin 4 = GND.
Half B: the optional source B below, or if it is not fitted, pin 5 to GND and pin 6 to pin 7.
Secure Element and Display, Software I2C at 3 V
Both modules: VCC to 3V and GND to GND. Lines that cross without a dot are not connected.
Optional Second Noise Source (Source B), the Same Circuit on Half B of U1
Fed from HVF like source A and biased from the same VREF. The firmware finds it on PB1 at power-up; entropy is credited to source A only.
